employees.csv: One row per employee. Includes demographics, org attributes, compensation, engagement and synthetic attrition target.
performance_reviews.csv: One annual performance review per employee per year for 2021–2025 (60,000 rows).
monthly_attendance.csv: One employee-month attendance summary for 2021–2025 (720,000 rows).
recruitment_pipeline.csv: One row per candidate application (5,000 rows).
